statement: Every analytic-rank label in the cubic, quartic and sextic coefficient tables has an exact root-number or non-torsion-point vanishing proof and a rigorous Arb nonvanishing interval with an explicit infinite-tail and Taylor-remainder bound.
depends_on: Modularity and functional equation; Hasse bound; Rubin1987 Corollary C and Remark(3); exact PARI arithmetic; Arb rigorous enclosure arithmetic
notes: All raw exact coefficient vectors, minimal models, changes of variables, point certificates and interval bounds are preserved. No ellanalyticrank tolerance or unproved denominator bound is used.

statement: The 81 positive cube-free coefficient classes supported at 2,3,5,7 have analytic-rank counts 34,41,6 in ranks 0,1,2 respectively, with no unresolved classes.
notes: Rank-two classes d=30,126,210,420,2100,2205 have saved certified second derivatives. Sign is redundant modulo rational cubes.

statement: All 6561 cubic pairs are tabulated; the rank-zero criterion settles 2754, with 2654 empty section sets, 97 cusp-only cases and 3 ordinary-plus-cusp cases.
depends_on: A.24; A.27; A.38; exact torsion bound, division polynomials, Hessian and valuation obstruction
notes: Exceptional pairs (1,2),(2,1),(4,4) have tripod values -1,2,1/2. Every cusp packet is given by its complete Kummer congruence. Unsettled rows do not assert emptiness.

statement: The 512 quartic coefficient curves y²=x³+Ax supported at 2,3,5,7 have exact analytic-rank counts 220,256,36 in ranks 0,1,2 respectively.
notes: Every coefficient sign and fourth-power class included; no unresolved class.

statement: The 2592 sextic coefficient curves y²=x³+B supported at 2,3,5,7 have exact analytic-rank counts 1136,1296,160 in ranks 0,1,2 respectively.
notes: Every coefficient sign and sixth-power class included; no unresolved class. All ten elliptic target families reduce to this coefficient table.

statement: The complete quartic 262144-row and sextic 6718464-row CSVs record every quotient criterion and every Selmer section in the settled classes, using exact class, point and cusp-packet dictionaries.
answers: A.7 complete quartic and sextic pair criteria and Selmer-section lists
notes: Quartic criterion settles213496:212200empty,1293cusp-only,3ordinary-only. Sextic settles6689532:6681792empty,7725cusp-only,15ordinary-only. Lossless gzip and executable decoder supplied; zero mask means unclassified.

statement: The smallest conductor among analytic-rank-one cubic twists y²=x³−432d² is243, attained by d=9, with minimal model y²+y=x³−1 and a certified nonzero first derivative.
depends_on: A.37–A.39; potential good reduction and inertia criterion; discriminant scaling; Rubin1987 Corollary C
answers: A.12 identification of the least-conductor rank-one curve
notes: Global minimality follows from conductor lower bounds and a finite exact list, not only from the S-supported census. Does not determine any profinite lifting set or claim that (1,0) is a primitive generator.
